display.purpose: The single thesis line on a surface. Archivo expanded, one per page.

label.purpose: The 10px caps name printed above a short value. Never a form question.

printed.purpose: Monospace for codes, amounts, durations and endpoints — measurement, not costume.

shadows.name: contact
shadows.purpose: A ticket lying on a desk. The only shadow in the system; passes and coupon strips only.

shadows.name: contact-sm
shadows.purpose: The lit top edge of stock on in-page cards, with no cast shadow.

motion.name: scan-cycle
motion.purpose: The hero sweep and its status flip share this duration and switch at 46%, so the beam reaching the code's bottom edge and the status re-printing are one event.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committing action. Flat process blue, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #1c39bb; color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 11px 20px; font: 600 14px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.005em; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), transform .08s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #2a4ae0; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c39bb; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The secondary door. Its border must be ink-mute — a rule-colored border is 1.19:1 on buff and reads as no border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #1a1712; border: 1px solid #6f6757; border-radius: 8px; padding: 11px 20px; font: 600 14px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s, border-color .16s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f3ecdd; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c39bb; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stamped Field
components.description: The system's atom: a caps field name over a monospace value.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; margin: 0; } .ds-field dt { font: 700 10px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6f6757; } .ds-field dd { margin: 0; font: 13px/1.4 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: -.01em; color: #1a1712; }

components.name: Perforation
components.description: The tear line, terminated by ground-filled notches so the card reads as physically punched.
components.css: .ds-perf { position: relative; height: 30px; background: #faf6ee; } .ds-perf span { position: absolute; inset: 50% 14px auto 14px; height: 2px; transform: translateY(-50%); background: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, #d8cbb2 0 5px, transparent 5px 11px); } .ds-perf::after, .ds-perf i { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 22px; height: 22px; transform: translateY(-50%); border-radius: 50%; background: #e7ddc9; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(26,23,18,.12); } .ds-perf::after { left: -11px; } .ds-perf i { right: -11px; }

components.name: State Chip
components.description: Financial state, printed as a rectangle. Held (ochre) and posted (green) are the two that carry money meaning.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid; font: 700 10.5px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip-held { color: #8a4e00; background: #f6ecd8; border-color: #e3c893; } .ds-chip-posted { color: #0a6b4a; background: #e4f0e9; border-color: #b6d8c8; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Sentence-case label over a stock-filled input. Labels are questions, so they are not stamped caps.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-i">Coins granted per verified signup</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-i" value="50">
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font: 550 13px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.004em; color: #4e483a; margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #d8cbb2; border-radius: 8px; background: #faf6ee; color: #1a1712; font: 14.5px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color .16s, box-shadow .16s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #6f6757; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #1c39bb; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(28,57,187,.22); }

components.name: Section Rule
components.description: A stamped section name with a perforation running out from it — the portal's only section divider.
components.css: .ds-h2 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font: 700 10px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6f6757; margin: 38px 0 12px; } .ds-h2::after { content: ""; flex: 1; height: 2px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, #d8cbb2 0 5px, transparent 5px 11px); }

narrative.overview:
A QR reward code is not a marketing asset. It is a spending instrument that leaves the building — printed on a boarding pass, a receipt, a seatback card — and cannot be recalled once it is in the world. This system dresses the product as the thing it actually is: ticket stock. Buff card, thermal-black ink, a perforated tear line, a stub that gets scanned, and stamped caps labels over monospace values.

The palette does the product's accounting. Process blue is validation, ochre is value held back, green is value posted. A promoter reading any screen should be able to tell those three states apart without reading a label.

The rejected alternative was the category default: a dark SaaS gradient hero, a row of identical icon cards, and a logo strip of customers this product does not yet have. That page would have claimed trust. This one demonstrates a mechanism instead.
keyCharacteristics: Printed, not rendered — no gradients, no glass, no glow
Three inks with fixed jobs: validation, held, posted
Monospace for every printed field; caps labels stamped above their values
Perforation and notch as the system's signature geometry
Motion is one authored event, not decoration

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Blue validates, ochre holds, green posts. A number rendered in the wrong ink is a factual error, not a style choice.

rules.name: The Buff Ground Rule
rules.body: ink-mute is only legible on stock (5.19:1), not on paper (4.15:1). Any muted text sitting directly on the page ground steps up to ink-soft.

rules.name: The Committed Stock Rule
rules.body: This world does not follow the OS theme. Surfaces set color-scheme: light and restate any inherited token.

rules.name: The Stamped Field Rule
rules.body: A fact with a short name is a field: a 10px uppercase label at 0.14em over a monospace value. A form label that asks a question is a sentence, not a field.

rules.name: The One Display Line Rule
rules.body: Exactly one Display-sized line per surface. A second one means neither is the thesis.

rules.name: The Contact Shadow Rule
rules.body: One shadow, on the ticket only. Panels, chips, buttons and boards are flat and rely on a 1px rule for their edge.

dos: Do print every fact as a stamped label plus a monospace value.
Do keep the three inks on their jobs: blue validates, ochre holds, green posts.
Do subdivide a run of related items with perforations inside one container.
Do set color-scheme: light and restate inherited tokens on any surface built in this world.
Do step muted text up to ink-soft whenever it sits on the buff ground.
Do give a surface exactly one authored motion event, tied to the mechanism it explains.
Do label synthetic or illustrative data in the container that holds it.
donts: Don't use backdrop-filter, glass, gradients on text, or a glowing shadow. This world is printed.
Don't build a grid of equally-sized icon-plus-heading cards.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't give an element a scroll entrance just because it is a section.
Don't animate something the reader will never see running — a scroll-linked effect below the fold needs animation-timeline: view().
Don't claim customers, logos, testimonials or traction. There are none to show yet.
Don't use a pill radius for a printed field or state chip.
